local_checks.invariant: No failure path leaves a request pending forever with a live writer, delivers a reply to the wrong request, or reuses a dead child
local_checks.result: An already-aborted signal rejects before spawning (gateway-client.mjs:80-84). Abort fails every pending request and SIGTERMs the child (:91-94, :219-228). The ready timer (:143-147) rejects the gate and kills; it is cleared on resolve or reject. Child error and close (:160-170) fail all pending requests and forget the child, so the next request respawns (:131); handlers check that the event is from the current child. A request settles once (:85-90) and removes its abort listener. close() ends stdin and waits for close (:121-128), and the adapter registers it as the cordis effect's cleanup (index.mjs:78). Every effect stays inside the operator's own DSH process.

hardening_notes: Aborting one request kills the shared child and rejects every concurrent request of the same client (gateway-client.mjs:91-94, :219-224); concurrent DSH turns in one process lose their in-flight replies. Same-principal availability only.

close() waits for the child's close event with no deadline (gateway-client.mjs:121-128); a gateway that ignores stdin EOF would hang plugin disposal. A bounded wait followed by SIGTERM would close it.

local_checks.invariant: The adapter does not move credential material from the gateway into a sink a lower-trust reader can see
local_checks.result: The plugin itself reads and forwards no credential: the child's environment is the allowlist (gateway-client.mjs:26-33; config.mjs:4-7), and requests carry only model, messages, tools and limits (translate.mjs:12-54). Error text carries at most the last 4096 bytes of the child's stderr (gateway-client.mjs:9, :174-176, :168, :237-240), the first 200 characters of an unparseable stdout line (:189), and the gateway's own error detail (translate.mjs:100-109); index.mjs:49 and :53 wrap them into LlmError. Whether that text ever holds secret material depends on what omp prints, and whether an LlmError reaches a sink outside the operator's account depends on the loading profile. At this head no profile loads the plugin (a repository search for omp-gateway finds only the plugin's own files), and the proof runner's scratch profile disables session-log upload (proof/run-proof.mjs:43). No reachable lower-trust reader exists at this head.

hardening_notes: Error messages forward the gateway child's stderr tail and a prefix of an unparseable stdout line (gateway-client.mjs:168, :189). Before a profile that uploads session logs loads this plugin, drop the tail from the message (keep it in a local debug channel) or bound it to known-safe fields.

local_checks.invariant: Model or user content cannot split or forge a request line, and a reply can satisfy only the request it names on the channel it came from
local_checks.result: Each request is one JSON.stringify({id, path, body}) line (gateway-client.mjs:107); JSON.stringify escapes newline and carriage return inside strings, so no message text, tool schema or model id from toMessagesBody (translate.mjs:12-54) can end the line or add a second request. path is the constant /v1/messages (index.mjs:47). Replies arrive only on the stdout pipe of the child this client spawned (:132, :177-179); the pipes are private to that process pair, so no other local peer can write a reply. #onLine (:183-212) requires a JSON object, the ready line first, integer id and status, and an id that is pending; anything else is a protocol failure that rejects all pending requests and kills the child (:214-217). Request ids increase per client (:103). Lines from a replaced child are ignored (:178).

hardening_notes: readline imposes no line-length bound on the child's stdout (gateway-client.mjs:177); the child is the operator's own omp process, so this is robustness, not a boundary.
